decision: PHASE 09ZF CONTROLLED LOA GATE ORDERING REMEDIATION PASS WITH STRICT RECOMMENDATIONS
rootCause: In pipeline.js, the Step 12.6 clarification route gate executed and could early-exit with a generic clarification fallback BEFORE the Step 12.65 controlled LOA gate ever ran. The 09ZE domain-boundary overlay correctly let the four narrow audit-procedure queries (replacement eLA, consolidated eLA, notice for presentation/submission, reminder before subpoena) reach the defense-in-depth boundary check with an ALLOW decision, but it did not change the later Step 12.6-before-Step-12.65 ordering, so those four queries were still intercepted by the clarification gate's generic fallback before Step 12.65 could classify them as safe controlled LOA/eLA procedural-help.
chosenRemediation: Reordered the two existing gate blocks in pipeline.js so the Step 12.65 controlled LOA gate (evaluateControlledLoaAskGate / buildControlledLoaAskEarlyExitResponse) now executes before the Step 12.6 clarification route gate (evaluateClarificationRouteGate). Neither gate's internal classification logic was changed. A query the controlled LOA gate classifies as safe now early-exits with controlled_loa_answer before the clarification gate can intercept it. A query the controlled LOA gate classifies as excluded or unrelated (matched:false) falls through unchanged to the unmodified Step 12.6 clarification gate and existing fallback/human-review behavior, exactly as before this reordering.

runtimeOrderingEvidence.priorOrder: Step 12.6 clarification route gate (evaluateClarificationRouteGate) ran first; Step 12.65 controlled LOA gate (evaluateControlledLoaAskGate) ran second and was unreachable for queries the clarification gate early-exited on.
runtimeOrderingEvidence.newOrder: Step 12.65 controlled LOA gate (evaluateControlledLoaAskGate) now runs first; Step 12.6 clarification route gate (evaluateClarificationRouteGate) now runs second and only executes if the controlled LOA gate did not already early-exit.
runtimeOrderingEvidence.whyThisExplainsStagingFailure: evaluateControlledLoaAskGate(), called in isolation, correctly classified all four previously-failing queries as matched:true / controlled_loa_answer. The 09ZE local test suite only exercised the gate function directly and therefore could not observe the ordering defect. Only the full runPipeline() code path, exercised by live staging smoke, could surface the ordering bug -- consistent with the 09ZB post-09ZE staging fail evidence recorded in knowledge/CURRENT_STATE.md.
runtimeOrderingEvidence.changeScope: pipeline.js only; no change to evaluateControlledLoaAskGate, buildControlledLoaAskEarlyExitResponse, evaluateClarificationRouteGate, or clarification-route-orchestrator-helper.js internals.

privacyBoundary: No real taxpayer data used; fixture and test queries are synthetic procedural-help phrasing only.
